title: Moving a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Plan to a Replacement Unit — Re-Based Term Odometer and Move Tool
content:
# Moving a Fleet Plan to Its Replacement Unit

## Scope
Under the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, the expiration odometer of a fleet plan is re-based in one situation. The plan's unit is no longer registered to the customer, and the holder names as its replacement the unit delivered on the customer's single Kessler Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement that stands in closed status (the replacement unit). A move onto any other unit, or for a customer holding more than one agreement in closed status, is outside this rule.

For a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan moved, within this scope, onto the unit that replaced its retired unit, and only for such a move, the plan's expiration odometer is re-based. The plan still keeps its sale date, expiration date, visits remaining and price, and every other move keeps its expiration odometer.

## What a move records
After the move, the plan stands on the replacement unit: the replacement becomes the plan's covered vehicle. Its term end odometer becomes the reading given. Its sale date, term end date, visits remaining and price stay as they are.

## Move tool: `move_fleet_plan_badb11fe`
**Capability.** Moves an active Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan from a unit the fleet has retired onto the unit that replaced it, with the effects described above.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `move_fleet_plan_badb11fe` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `maintenance_plan_id` | Reference number of the fleet plan being moved, as returned by the maintenance plan lookup | Id |
| `replacement_vehicle_id` | Reference number of the replacement unit, as returned by the vehicle lookup for this customer | Id |
| `expiration_odometer` | The odometer reading on the replacement unit at which the plan term ends | Integer miles, whole miles, no separators |

**Return.** A text receipt listing `maintenance_plan_id`, `previous_vehicle_id` (the retired unit's reference number), `vehicle_id` (the replacement unit now covered), `expiration_odometer` (whole miles) and `status` (unchanged, normally active).
